instruction: Candid full shot in profile of an indoor gym with grey mats. On the left, the man in the grey t-shirt and black shorts (R2) stands on one leg, executing a powerful right roundhouse kick. On the right, the man in the white t-shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands defensively, blocking the incoming kick with his forearms. The background is simple with grey wall padding and tripods. Even overhead lighting illuminates the scene with neutral tones.
